hook: Your Nespresso has a secret button combo.

steps.say: Eject the capsule and empty the drip tray.
Fill the tank with descaler and half a litre of water.
On most models, hold both buttons for three seconds, until they blink fast.
Run it through, then rinse with water.

safety.say: Use a proper descaler only, and don't add vinegar on top.
safety.text: Descaler only. No vinegar on top.
